item.title: Seijaku wa Yami no Shirabe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Remain
  • 発売日: 2003-05-30
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 静寂は闇の調べ
  • 英語名: Seijaku wa Yami no Shirabe

あらすじ

Few years after the World War II, the protagonist receives a letter naming him as heir to the inheritance by his sick biological father - the fact that he has no memory of, yet which his current parents reluctantly admits as true.

He returns to his hometown with intention of rejecting the offer, and meets a relative who still remembers him from her childhood. As the stay unintentionally grows longer, sequence of strange events begins to take place against him…

item.title: Trois
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Remain
  • 発売日: 2001-10-05
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Trois～トロワ～
  • 英語名: Trois

あらすじ

An omnibus of three stories.

Psychic route

A villain aiming for world conquest awakens the protagonist’s hidden power and tries to exploit it. To prevent this, the protagonist’s younger sister, Haruno, takes a stand.

Fantasy route

Three girls are, in fact, reincarnations of fairies and youkai. This truth gradually becomes known to the protagonist, and a gentle, understated story unfolds, depicting a love triangle where they are drawn to each other yet remain conflicted.
